xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Income Tax Department/Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
The company received a favourable order under section 250 of the Income-tax Act, 1961 dated 31-01-2024, by the Ld. CIT(A), wherein, Excise Duty Exemption was treated as capital receipt for Financial Year 2012-13. Consequently, the Company received Income-tax refund of Rs. 1788.24 lakh and interest on Income-tax refund of Rs 786.70 lakh.
As the said amount pertains to the period prior to demerger pursuant to the Composite Scheme of Arrangement between Greenply Industries Limited and Greenpanel Industries Limited, and in accordance with the agreement dated 24th January, 2020 between the said parties, 50% of the said amount (i.e., Income-tax refund of Rs. 894.12 lakh and Rs. 393.35 lakh for interest thereon) was shared with Greenpanel Industries Limited.
Subsequently the Income Tax Department has filed an appeal before the Hon'ble ITAT, Guwahati Bench on 21-06-2024
The tax effect of the aggregate amount under litigation as on 31-12-2024 is Rs. 1764.23 lakh plus applicable interest upto 31-12-2024.
If any liability arises as a result of the litigation before the Hon'ble ITAT, Guwahati Bench, 50% of such liability shall be borne by Greenpanel Industries Limited.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Hon’ble ITAT, Guwahati Bench, vide its order dated 15-12-2025, has dismissed the appeal filed by the Income-tax Department, thereby upholding the order of the Ld. CIT(A).
